exposure: Previous abdominal surgeries (Laparotomy, Gynecological operations, Open Cholecystectomy, Open Appendicectomy)
outcome: Post-operative complications of hernia repair (seroma, surgical site infection)
cohort: 36 patients (23 female, 13 male, mean age 48.36 years, ranging from 25 to 70 years) diagnosed with incisional hernia presenting at a tertiary care hospital.
finding: Laparotomies (58.3%) and gynecological operations (33.4%) were the major contributing procedures leading to incisional hernias, with open onlay mesh repair being the most common treatment modality, and seroma and surgical site infection as observed post-operative complications.
mod_finding: LSCS was a major contributing gynecological surgery for incisional hernia, accounting for 10 (27.8%) of the 36 cases.
